mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_LeastPrivilege allows the model to invent states where clinical roles can access AuditSearch or AuditOfficer can access RecordsLookup, violating the permission matrix. This is exactly what the LeastPrivilege and FR_011 assertions are designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { (Doctor -> AuditSearch in PermMatrix.Allowed) or (AuditOfficer -> RecordsLookup not in PermMatrix.Allowed) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows two distinct audit entries to record the same clinician, patient, and outcome, simulating a mutation or duplicate. AppendOnly and FR_010_AuditImmutable both expect all audit entries to be distinguishable.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.clinician = ae2.clinician and ae1.patient_ref = ae2.patient_ref and ae1.outcome = ae2.outcome }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnershipBasedAccess allows audit entries with outcome=Permitted to exist without any active care-team membership. This violates the core access-control invariant that permitted access requires care-team membership.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.outcome = Permitted and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = ae.clinician and ctm.patient = ae.patient_ref and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoInformationLeakage allows audit entries with outcome=Denied to have authorisation_basis=PatientNotFound (and vice versa), or with outcome=Permitted but basis=NotCareTeamMember, revealing whether the patient exists to the requester.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InformationLeakageViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.outcome = Denied and ae.authorisation_basis = PatientNotFound) or (ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.authorisation_basis = NotCareTeamMember) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AttributionCorrectness allows an audit entry to record a clinician_role that does not match the clinician's actual role, causing misattribution in the audit log.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, u: User | ae.clinician = u and ae.clinician_role != u.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_FR_006_CareTeamMembership allows Permitted outcomes to exist without corresponding active care-team memberships, or allows permitted outcomes to be granted to users not on the care team.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, u: User | ae.clinician = u and ae.outcome = Permitted and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = ae.clinician and ctm.patient = ae.patient_ref and ctm.status = Active }
